findings.desc: Lattice-Engineering-Baseline-Unlock-Execution-Plan.md:186 defines digest-backed evidence refs as string refs using artifact:<file>#sha256=<64-hex>, and line 210 explicitly requires gateEvidenceRefs[] to use that string format. Section 10 then says any *EvidenceRefs entry is malformed if it is missing a digest field and line 806 requires refusalEvidenceRefs to have refusalType, which implies object-form entries. This is an internal contract contradiction for gate/refusal evidence refs and should block quality review until the document consistently specifies either digest-backed string refs or object refs.

Coverage evidence is not replayable for CHK-001:edge:0 and CHK-002:adversarial:0. checklist_get records docs_check result=pass for `node -e "check document contains implementation-readiness/local diagnostic/audit-only proof boundaries"` and for `git diff --check main...HEAD && node -e "check stale/fake/localOnly/malformed/generic blockedReasons conditions"`, but replaying the node commands exits 1 with SyntaxError: Unexpected identifier. git diff --check main...HEAD passes and the document has matching content, but these verificationEvidence records claim PASS for commands that cannot execute, so coverage evidence must be replaced with executable rg/node checks or refreshed evidence before REVIEW can pass.
